⚠️ The refine pipeline needs fixes: the session page's new Coverage tab will show every ask as "unreviewed" and every session at 0%. It looks for fields at the top of each line of `asks-outcomes.jsonl`, but the file nests them one level down and stores session ids as 8-character prefixes. On top of that, the 7-day run never happened, there are no screenshots proving the tab on three sessions, and two code comments point at a doc that doesn't exist.

The rest meets the brief. The queue runs one Haiku call per prompt, at most N at once. Haiku's refinements scored 0.90 in Opus's first review and 0.96 after the brief was rewritten.

My full review, with the fix for each problem, is in `refine-pipeline/review.md`.
